selector.rationale: Erdheim-Chester disease is supported by the presence of foamy histiocytes, fibrosis, and Touton-like giant cells, as well as the absence of granulomas and malignant cells, and positive immunohistochemical staining for CD68, CD163, and factor XIIIa.

rejected.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: Negative immunohistochemical staining for CD1a, S100, and langerin, and the presence of Touton-like giant cells, which are more characteristic of Erdheim-Chester disease.
